content.short: NF.td lets you mint a username and curate your web3 identity.
content.description: NF.td enables you to mint a unique username as a non-fungible token, then customize a dedicated profile tied to that name and link it anywhere. After you mint, the username is represented by a bespoke NFT stored on the blockchain, providing an on-chain record of the identity. You can tailor the NF.td profile for that username as your Web3 presence grows. NF.td is built specifically for Web3 communities and creators seeking a trusted, blockchain-backed identity.
content.meta: NF.td allows users to mint usernames, customize profiles, and link them anywhere. Discover NF.td and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
